title: Valuation Request
description: Input schema for comps_ev_revenue valuation method. Enforces deterministic selection and auditable assumptions.

request_id.description: Unique identifier for this valuation request. Echoed in the report for traceability.

as_of_date.description: Valuation reference date (ISO-8601). Echoed in the report.

currency.description: ISO-4217 currency code. Echoed in the report.

method.description: Valuation method. Only comps_ev_revenue is supported.

comps_selection.description: Controls which comps are selected and in what deterministic order.

universe.description: Named comp universe to draw from (must exist in provider dataset).

filters.description: All filters that restrict the candidate set before the max_comps limit is applied.

sector.description: Sector(s) to match. Candidate must belong to at least one listed sector (case-insensitive exact match).

size.description: Size bucket(s) to match. Candidate must belong to at least one listed size (e.g., ["mid", "large"]).

industry_keywords.description: At least one of the candidate's industry_tags must contain one of these keywords (case-insensitive substring).

geographies.description: Candidate geography must be in this list (case-insensitive exact match).

revenue_band.description: Min/max revenue filter. Runtime validates min <= max.

max_comps.description: Upper limit on included comps after filtering. Excess comps excluded with reason 'limit_max_comps'.

oneOf.description: Default: relevance-based ranking by revenue proximity to subject (deterministic with company_id tie-breaker).

sort_key.description: Sort strategy. If null or omitted, uses relevance-based ranking (revenue proximity). If array, uses lexicographic sort for backward compatibility.

assumptions.description: Analyst-chosen assumptions that affect the computation. All are recorded in the report for auditability.

outlier_policy.description: How to handle outlier multiples. 'trim' removes tails, 'winsorize' clamps tails to boundaries (computed via quantile_method), 'none' keeps all.

outlier_quantile.description: Fraction of each tail to treat as outliers (e.g., 0.1 = 10th/90th percentile boundaries).

quantile_method.description: Algorithm for computing q25/q50/q75. Defaults to 'linear_interpolation' if not specified.
